'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Chris Fanchi LS Hoth: North Ridge''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)|Hoth-L-hothnorthridge.gif|label=Hoth: North Ridge}}
* '''Deck name:''' Philadelphia is Cold
* '''Username:''' Artwo180
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
